verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies native in-tool conversation. Agent-focused docs say users can message agents in item "updates" and "@mention them in any conversation", which suggests monday has threaded update conversations with @mentions next to the work items. However, no evidence describes person-to-person team chat directly, and the Slack/Teams integrations are external tools that earn no credit. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of team-to-team messaging (updates/threads, direct messages, notifications), coverage of real-time chat vs. async comments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
